description: Use this when the user asks what went down, whether anything is down now, what happened last night or this month, or what maintenance is planned. Returns incidents (open or resolved, with how each was confirmed) or maintenance windows, for one site, a group or the account, newest first. Not for one incident's full evidence: use get_incident.

from.description: Instead of range: where the window starts, a date such as 2026-07-01 (in your time zone) or RFC 3339. Goes with to. A window is at most 90 days, within the history your plan keeps.

group.description: Only sites in this group (exact name).

range.description: How far back (default 30d). Clamped to the history your plan keeps.

site.description: Only this site: its id, name or part of its URL.

to.description: Instead of range: where the window ends, a date (the whole day is included) or RFC 3339.

name: list_incidents
title: List incidents and maintenance
